stoicism.text: You have power over your mind - not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
stoicism.author: Marcus Aurelius

stoicism.text: We suffer more often in imagination than in reality.
stoicism.author: Seneca

stoicism.text: It's not what happens to you, but how you react to it that matters.
stoicism.author: Epictetus

stoicism.text: Waste no more time arguing about what a good man should be. Be one.
stoicism.author: Marcus Aurelius

motivation.text: The secret of getting ahead is getting started.
motivation.author: Mark Twain

motivation.text: It always seems impossible until it's done.
motivation.author: Nelson Mandela

motivation.text: Whether you think you can or you think you can't, you're right.
motivation.author: Henry Ford

motivation.text: Don't watch the clock; do what it does. Keep going.
motivation.author: Sam Levenson

creativity.text: You can't use up creativity. The more you use, the more you have.
creativity.author: Maya Angelou

creativity.text: The chief enemy of creativity is good sense.
creativity.author: Pablo Picasso

engineering.text: Programs must be written for people to read, and only incidentally for machines to execute.
engineering.author: Harold Abelson

engineering.text: We can solve any problem by introducing an extra level of indirection.
engineering.author: David Wheeler

engineering.text: Premature optimization is the root of all evil.
engineering.author: Donald Knuth

humor.text: I'm not lazy, I'm on energy-saving mode.
humor.author: Anonymous

humor.text: There are two hard things in computer science: cache invalidation, naming things, and off-by-one errors.
humor.author: Phil Karlton (adapted)

humor.text: I would love to change the world, but they won't give me the source code.
humor.author: Anonymous
